limitations: Snapshot review only; no filesystem or commands.
Requires a concurrent writer with evidence directory access.
confirmed_defect.mechanism: A destination leaf can be replaced with a hardlink to outside data after precheck and before shutil.copyfile opens it. The copy writes through that hardlink. Recreating a regular nlink=1 leaf before the postcheck permits successful return despite outside overwrite.
minimum_reproduction: normal staging source and evidence destination
between destination precheck and copy, replace destination with an NTFS hardlink to outside file
copy writes source bytes through destination link to outside file
replace destination with normal nlink=1 leaf before final target check
confirmed_defect.required_repair: Use a bound-evidence temporary file plus atomic destination replacement; add a controlled destination-swap regression that verifies outside bytes remain unchanged.

prior_unresponsive_review_attempt.result: no usable verdict; agent was shutdown after transport nonresponse; not counted as review.
